title: Connect to a host or port using Telnet
summary: Use the telnet command to open a raw TCP connection to a specific host or port. This is often used for testing if a service is reachable or for interacting with simple text-based protocols.

steps.explain: Connect to the default port (usually 23) of a specified host.

placeholders.name: HOST
placeholders.description: The hostname or IP address to connect to

steps.explain: Connect to a specific port on a host. Useful for testing if a service is listening.

placeholders.name: IP_ADDRESS
placeholders.description: The IP address or hostname of the target

placeholders.name: PORT
placeholders.description: The port number to connect to
